name: SARIF Static Analysis Reports
description: Browse SARIF 2.1.0 static analysis reports offline: filter findings by tool, rule, file and severity, inspect locations, code flows and suppressions, and optionally link a local source root.
privacy: Offline analysis · messages render as plain text · reports and source are never written to history
limits: Up to 32 reports per run; 16 MiB per file, 32 MiB total; JSON depth 64; results, locations and rules together capped at 50,000 entries. UTF-8 and SARIF 2.x only.

help: Open or drop one or more UTF-8 SARIF 2.1.0 reports (.sarif / .json). Multiple runs are listed per tool, keeping tool name, version and column counting kind.
Level resolution follows the spec: explicit result.level first, then the rule's default level, then kind (fail → error, everything else → none). A missing level is never silently treated as an error.

ruleId/ruleIndex mismatches, out-of-range indexes and unresolved message templates keep their raw values and land in diagnostics; external property files and extension components are flagged only, never fetched.
Suppressed results are never deleted; suppression records and baselineState are displayed independently. Selecting a result reveals locations, snippets, related locations and inlined code flow steps.

Local files are read only after you link a source root: URIs are percent-decoded first, traversal, backslashes and NUL are rejected, and the final path must stay inside the root (symlinks included). Without a line range the tool refuses to guess.

Up to 32 files, 16 MiB per file, 32 MiB total; depth 64; results, locations and rules together capped at 50,000 entries. Exports follow the current filter, max 64 MiB; over-limit inputs are rejected, never trimmed. Only the most recent parse cache is kept; no database is created.

parse.summary: Parse one or more SARIF reports and return a result summary
